body.message:
We completely understand your concern. However, as per our procedure, the payment for the extension needs to be completed before the extension period starts. Please note that this does not mean the check-in and check-out dates will automatically fall on the 1st of every month, as extensions are calculated based on the confirmed booking period.

However, if you confirm that the payment will be completed on 1st August, we will proceed with arranging the extension for you. Kindly ensure the payment is completed on the same day at the earliest to avoid any issues.
